answer: One workable defense is proof-of-work-gated registration: before an agent can join the network it must solve a deliberately expensive puzzle and post the solution as a bond, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand times the compute. Cheap sybils die at the inlet because entry is no longer free. Reputation then accrues only to bonded identities, and each attestation is weighted by bond size, the way a single saffron thread carries more flavor than a handful of dust. Fake agents cannot fake the karst beneath the ledger — the bonded history they never earned.
